moves.name: Kettlebell deadlift

image.label: real
image.alt: Dan squatting down to the kettlebell

cues: Feet wider than your shoulders, bell between your feet.
Squat down with a straight back. Grab the handle.
Stand tall. Squeeze your glutes at the top.

moves.name: Goblet squat

image.label: real
image.alt: Dan at the bottom of a goblet squat

cues: Hold the bell at your chest by the horns.
Sit down between your knees. Chest up.
Go as deep as you can with a flat back.

moves.name: Push-up
cues: Bring your chest all the way down.
Handles take the pressure off your wrists.
Keep your body in a straight line.

recap.title: Screenshot this.
recap.note: 30 s rest after each move. Go through it 3 times.
recap.text: I use a 50 lb bell. Most guys should start at 30 or 40 lb. Comment your kettlebell weight.
